cards.description_en: Fires peas in a straight line at zombies.
Produces sun periodically to fund more plants.
Explodes over a 3-by-3 area and damages nearby zombies.
Blocks zombies with a durable defensive shell.
Fires peas that damage and slow the zombie they hit.
Swallows one nearby zombie, then pauses while digesting.
Fires two peas in succession down its lane.
A high, durable barrier that stops vaulting zombies.
Lobs melons that deal splash damage to nearby zombies.
An upgrade for Sunflower that produces twice as much sun.

zombie_abilities.description_en: A basic zombie that walks toward the house and bites plants.
A basic zombie whose traffic cone provides extra damage protection.
Carries a screen door that blocks many projectiles; fume attacks pierce it.
A fast, durable zombie wearing football equipment.

Explodes over a 3-by-3 area and damages nearby zombies.
Blocks zombies with a durable defensive shell.
Fires peas that damage and slow the zombie they hit.
Swallows one nearby zombie, then pauses while digesting.
Fires two peas in succession down its lane.
A high, durable barrier that stops vaulting zombies.
Lobs melons that deal splash damage to nearby zombies.
An upgrade for Sunflower that produces twice as much sun.

cards.description_en: Fires peas in a straight line at zombies.
Produces sun periodically to fund more plants.
Explodes over a 3-by-3 area and damages nearby zombies.
Blocks zombies with a durable defensive shell.
Fires peas that damage and slow the zombie they hit.
Swallows one nearby zombie, then pauses while digesting.
Fires two peas in succession down its lane.
A high, durable barrier that stops vaulting zombies.
Lobs melons that deal splash damage to nearby zombies.
An upgrade for Sunflower that produces twice as much sun.

Explodes over a 3-by-3 area and damages nearby zombies.
Blocks zombies with a durable defensive shell.
Fires peas that damage and slow the zombie they hit.
Swallows one nearby zombie, then pauses while digesting.
Fires two peas in succession down its lane.
A high, durable barrier that stops vaulting zombies.
Lobs melons that deal splash damage to nearby zombies.
An upgrade for Sunflower that produces twice as much sun.

zombie_abilities.description_en: A basic zombie whose traffic cone provides extra damage protection.
Carries a screen door that blocks many projectiles; fume attacks pierce it.

Carries a screen door that blocks many projectiles; fume attacks pierce it.

cards.description_en: Fires peas in a straight line at zombies.
Produces sun periodically to fund more plants.
Explodes over a 3-by-3 area and damages nearby zombies.
Blocks zombies with a durable defensive shell.
Fires peas that damage and slow the zombie they hit.
Swallows one nearby zombie, then pauses while digesting.
Fires two peas in succession down its lane.
A high, durable barrier that stops vaulting zombies.
Lobs melons that deal splash damage to nearby zombies.
An upgrade for Sunflower that produces twice as much sun.

cards.description_en: Fires peas in a straight line at zombies.
Produces sun periodically to fund more plants.
Explodes over a 3-by-3 area and damages nearby zombies.
Blocks zombies with a durable defensive shell.
Fires peas that damage and slow the zombie they hit.
Swallows one nearby zombie, then pauses while digesting.
Fires two peas in succession down its lane.
A high, durable barrier that stops vaulting zombies.
Lobs melons that deal splash damage to nearby zombies.
An upgrade for Sunflower that produces twice as much sun.

Carries a screen door that blocks many projectiles; fume attacks pierce it.
A basic zombie whose traffic cone provides extra damage protection.
A fast, durable zombie wearing football equipment.

cards.description_en: Fires peas in a straight line at zombies.
Produces sun periodically to fund more plants.
Explodes over a 3-by-3 area and damages nearby zombies.
Blocks zombies with a durable defensive shell.
Fires peas that damage and slow the zombie they hit.
Swallows one nearby zombie, then pauses while digesting.
Fires two peas in succession down its lane.
A high, durable barrier that stops vaulting zombies.
Lobs melons that deal splash damage to nearby zombies.
An upgrade for Sunflower that produces twice as much sun.

Explodes over a 3-by-3 area and damages nearby zombies.
Blocks zombies with a durable defensive shell.
Fires peas that damage and slow the zombie they hit.
Swallows one nearby zombie, then pauses while digesting.
Fires two peas in succession down its lane.
A high, durable barrier that stops vaulting zombies.
Lobs melons that deal splash damage to nearby zombies.
An upgrade for Sunflower that produces twice as much sun.

zombie_abilities.description_en: A basic zombie that walks toward the house and bites plants.
